001package io.jstach.rainbowgum.json.encoder;
002
003import java.util.function.Consumer;
004
005import org.jspecify.annotations.Nullable;
006
007import io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogEncoder;
008import io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogEvent;
009import io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogFormatter.LevelFormatter;
010import io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogProperties;
011import io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogProvider;
012import io.jstach.rainbowgum.annotation.LogConfigurable;
013import io.jstach.rainbowgum.json.JsonBuffer;
014import io.jstach.rainbowgum.json.JsonBuffer.ExtendedFieldPrefix;
015import io.jstach.rainbowgum.json.JsonBuffer.JSONToken;
016
017/**
018 * A JSON encoder resembling
019 * <a href="https://logback.qos.ch/manual/encoders.html#JsonEncoder">Logback's own
020 * opinionated <code>ch.qos.logback.classic.encoder.JsonEncoder</code></a>.
021 * <p>
022 * Fields written: <code>timestamp</code> (epoch millis), <code>nanoseconds</code>
023 * (nanosecond-of-second, for sub-millisecond precision), <code>level</code>,
024 * <code>threadName</code>, <code>loggerName</code>, <code>mdc</code> (nested object of
025 * the event's key values), <code>message</code> (already formatted), and
026 * <code>throwable</code> (nested object with <code>className</code>, <code>message</code>
027 * and a <code>stepArray</code> of stack frame objects, recursing into <code>cause</code>
028 * if present).
029 * <p>
030 * Unlike Logback's encoder, which is independently configurable per field via
031 * {@code <withXxx>} elements, <code>sequenceNumber</code> is intentionally not
032 * implemented (Rainbow Gum has no context-wide sequence number generator, see
033 * {@code %lsn}/{@code %sn} in the pattern module discussion), <code>context</code> is
034 * omitted (Rainbow Gum has no equivalent to Logback's {@code LoggerContext}), and
035 * <code>kvpList</code> is omitted because Rainbow Gum does not distinguish MDC-origin key
036 * values from SLF4J fluent {@code addKeyValue} ones - both already end up merged into
037 * {@link LogEvent#keyValues()}, which this encoder writes as <code>mdc</code>.
038 */
039public final class LogbackJsonEncoder extends LogEncoder.AbstractEncoder<JsonBuffer> {
040
041        /**
042         * Logback JSON encoder URI scheme.
043         */
044        public static final String LOGBACK_SCHEME = "logback";
045
046        private final boolean prettyprint;
047
048        private final int maxBufferSize;
049
050        LogbackJsonEncoder(boolean prettyprint, int maxBufferSize) {
051                super();
052                this.prettyprint = prettyprint;
053                this.maxBufferSize = maxBufferSize;
054        }
055
056        /**
057         * Creates a Logback JSON encoder using a lambda for easier registration. The builder
058         * will have properties loaded after the consumer has configured the builder.
059         * @param consumer lambda to configure builder.
060         * @return encoder provider.
061         */
062        public static LogProvider<LogbackJsonEncoder> of(Consumer<LogbackJsonEncoderBuilder> consumer) {
063                return (s, c) -> {
064                        var b = new LogbackJsonEncoderBuilder(s);
065                        consumer.accept(b);
066                        return b.fromProperties(c.properties()).build();
067                };
068        }
069
070        /**
071         * Creates a Logback JSON encoder.
072         * @param name property name prefix.
073         * @param prettyPrint <code>true</code> will pretty print the JSON, default is false.
074         * @param maxBufferSize maximum buffer size - a soft ceiling checked between events,
075         * not a hard cap enforced on any single event (see
076         * {@link LogEncoder.Buffer#isOversized()}). A negative value (the default) disables
077         * this entirely.
078         * @return encoder.
079         */
080        @LogConfigurable(prefix = LogProperties.ENCODER_PREFIX)
081        static LogbackJsonEncoder of(@LogConfigurable.KeyParameter String name, @Nullable Boolean prettyPrint,
082                        @Nullable Integer maxBufferSize) {
083                prettyPrint = prettyPrint == null ? false : prettyPrint;
084                int _maxBufferSize = maxBufferSize == null ? -1 : maxBufferSize;
085                return new LogbackJsonEncoder(prettyPrint, _maxBufferSize);
086        }
087
088        @Override
089        protected JsonBuffer doBuffer(BufferHints hints) {
090                return new JsonBuffer(this.prettyprint, ExtendedFieldPrefix.UNDERSCORE, maxBufferSize);
091        }
092
093        @Override
094        protected void doEncode(LogEvent event, JsonBuffer buffer) {
095                buffer.clear();
096                var formattedMessage = buffer.getFormattedMessageBuilder();
097                event.formattedMessage(formattedMessage);
098                var now = event.timestamp();
099                var t = event.throwableOrNull();
100
101                buffer.write(JSONToken.OBJECT_START);
102                int index = 0;
103                index = buffer.writeLong("timestamp", now.toEpochMilli(), index, 0);
104                index = buffer.writeInt("nanoseconds", now.getNano(), index, 0);
105                index = buffer.write("level", LevelFormatter.toString(event.level()), index);
106                index = buffer.write("threadName", event.threadName(), index);
107                index = buffer.write("loggerName", event.loggerName(), index);
108
109                int mdcIndex = buffer.writeObjectStart("mdc", index, 0);
110                var kvs = event.keyValues();
111                for (int i = kvs.start(); i >= 0; i = kvs.next(i)) {
112                        mdcIndex = buffer.write(kvs.key(i), kvs.valueOrNull(i), mdcIndex, 0);
113                }
114                buffer.writeObjectEnd();
115                index++;
116
117                index = buffer.write("message", formattedMessage.toString(), index);
118
119                if (t != null) {
120                        index = writeThrowable("throwable", t, buffer, index);
121                }
122
123                if (index > 0 && prettyprint) {
124                        buffer.writeLineFeed();
125                }
126                buffer.write(JSONToken.OBJECT_END);
127                buffer.writeLineFeed();
128        }
129
130        private static int writeThrowable(String field, Throwable t, JsonBuffer buffer, int index) {
131                int throwableIndex = buffer.writeObjectStart(field, index, 0);
132                throwableIndex = buffer.write("className", t.getClass().getName(), throwableIndex, 0);
133                throwableIndex = buffer.write("message", t.getMessage(), throwableIndex, 0);
134
135                int arrayIndex = buffer.writeArrayStart("stepArray", throwableIndex, 0);
136                for (var frame : t.getStackTrace()) {
137                        int frameIndex = buffer.writeArrayElementObjectStart(arrayIndex);
138                        frameIndex = buffer.write("className", frame.getClassName(), frameIndex, 0);
139                        frameIndex = buffer.write("methodName", frame.getMethodName(), frameIndex, 0);
140                        frameIndex = buffer.write("fileName", frame.getFileName(), frameIndex, 0);
141                        frameIndex = buffer.writeInt("lineNumber", frame.getLineNumber(), frameIndex, 0);
142                        buffer.writeArrayElementObjectEnd();
143                        arrayIndex++;
144                }
145                buffer.writeArrayEnd();
146                throwableIndex++;
147
148                var cause = t.getCause();
149                if (cause != null && cause != t) {
150                        writeThrowable("cause", cause, buffer, throwableIndex);
151                }
152
153                buffer.writeObjectEnd();
154                return index + 1;
155        }
156
157}
